turns.query: Our salt sensor has been reading low and a soft brush around the electrodes didn't bring it back. The vendor sheet just says to clean it chemically without saying what with. What do the field manuals put you in?

relevant.evidence: • Electrodes dirty—first clean with a detergent solution, then if necessary with 5-percent HCl.
relevant.locator: Table 6.3-3 Troubleshooting guide and Section 7.0 — "Symptom / Possible cause and corrective action"

relevant.evidence: should not be cleaned in nitric acid (HNO3), aqua
relevant.locator: Section 2.2.1 cleaning and storage and Section 3.0 Calibration — "Specific conductance measurements are only as good as the calibration itself"
